_meta.note: positionAge is entirely client-reported and never cross-checked against server-observed time. A client can claim its position is fresh indefinitely.

contrastField.name: sinceSeconds
contrastField.note: Server-set and read-only per docs/GROUP_RELAY.md — cannot be spoofed the same way, because the relay computes it from when it last heard from the member at all, not from anything the client sends.

scenario.modeledEffect: Squadmates reading positionAge see a marker that always looks fresh, even though the underlying screenshot position has not updated in 30 minutes.
